## Source freshness risks (curated)

Hand-maintained; the generator round-trips this block verbatim. Edit freely
between the sentinels.

- FanGraphs: Cloudflare-blocks scripted Python fetches, so board/article
  ingestion is WebFetch-only plus manual CSV drops staged by step 0b
  (`fangraphs_csv.py`). Deep-tier article grades are unreliable; "Other
  Prospects of Note" maps to FV 30 by owner rule (2026-06-18).
- MLB StatsAPI is the load-bearing dependency: ids, transactions, IL,
  rosters, stats, fielding, and the self-computed leverage feed
  (`mlb_leverage.py` reads winProbability because FanGraphs gmLI is
  unreachable). No auth, but any schema or availability change breaks the
  daily path first.
- Baseball Savant CSV pulls are disk-cached (`feed_cache.py`); caches can go
  stale silently between forced refreshes, and minors Statcast coverage only
  starts 2023. Use --force to bypass the cache.
- `data/positions_played.json` refreshes on the MONTHLY cadence only:
  run_monthly step 3a-ii calls `fielding_positions.build_positions_played`,
  gated by --skip-stats (default runs). `run_daily()` never calls it, so
  mid-month position changes wait for the next monthly run (F-09 resolution,
  2026-07-01).
- Spotrac (IFA bonuses + contracts) is scraped on the monthly path,
  best-effort: a layout change fails soft and leaves the prior cache.
- TJStats and MLB Pipeline live boards are captured daily point-in-time;
  their histories are append-only and cannot be backfilled.
